Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misinterpreted the data and equation usage by (a) equating the “catalytic constant” directly to Vmax without verifying its definition (kcat vs. Vmax) and (b) plugging values into the Michaelis–Menten final equation without ensuring unit consistency between [S] and Km (e.g., treating 72.3 and 0.052 as the same units), which drives the result to incorrectly equal Vmax. This unverified mapping and unit mismatch led to the wrong velocity output.
